discourse.title: Purify The Mind And Focus It On Divinity
discourse.excerpt:
Oh foolish Mind!
Why do you go hither and thither in search of Brahman
when He is present in you?
Turn inward, and you will find Him there.
There is no greater fortune than this.
discourse.theme: Turn inward — purify the mind and focus it on Divinity.

reflection: O foolish mind — where are you rushing off to? Swami asks this of your restless thoughts with a smile: the Brahman you chase in temples and travels is sitting quietly within you. The day's practice is simple: when the mind scatters, gently call it back inward. There is no greater fortune than finding Him there.
seva_nudge: Spend five phone-free minutes in quiet with Swami's name. That stillness is today's seva to your own heart.
